column4: cleat#2205: both prove migration 103's BLOCK predicates against a LIVE SQL Server -- the first by attempting a cross-tenant write and checking it is refused, the second by reading sys.security_predicates directly and asserting every FILTER predicate on fn_tenant_filter has a matching BLOCK predicate. Neither has a dialect-suffixed subtest; each is a single flat t.Skip("CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL not set") when the DSN is absent, so each contributes exactly one skip event in this PostgreSQL-only job, not per-subtest. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run 'TestMSSQLBlockPredicatesRejectCrossTenantWrites|TestEveryMSSQLFilterPredicateHasAMatchingBlockPredicate' -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly two.
same two tests, and the cluster job sweeps ./engine/... too. See the test-go/engine line above.
